description: The sixth analysis kind. A flow asks where a value came from, a call shape asks what a call was written with, a store asks where a value was put -- and none of them can express a private key sitting in a constant, because it is not an argument, not a destination, and nothing reaches it. Every shape here is one a value either has or does not: there is no entropy score and no proximity to a variable named secret, because both are ways of guessing. The five negatives are the five things that share a shape without sharing its meaning, and four of them were measured on real code: a format example, a URL with no credential, a public key, a placeholder spelled like a Slack token, and a string that merely starts with the right four characters.

expected.note: a credential in a connection string
the Slack token shape, with the digit groups a placeholder does not have
a signed token: not a key, but presentable by anybody holding the repository
